authorization: User execute on 2026-11-16 supersedes GOAL.md document-only authorization; no deployment or monitoring
universe: BaoStock historical weekly CSI300 membership, retrospective Historical-proxy; original provider updateDate retained; no current membership backfill
daily_membership: Backward-asof provider updateDate; only at/after updateDate, weekly effective-date resolution; intraweek changes unknown
data_availability: Daily bar complete assumed 18:00 Asia/Shanghai; not first-vintage certified
signal: Last market session of W-FRI, discard terminal incomplete week
eligibility: 60 consecutive market-calendar positive conflict-free closes and at least 80% finite core features; no future-label/deletion filters
xs_transform: ddof=0; at least 100 valid contemporaneous members; zero variance becomes NaN
target: H10 adj_open[t+11]/adj_open[t+1]-1; fixed market calendar endpoints; no replacement endpoint; cross-sectional zscore ddof=0 minimum100
outer: 2021Q1 onward, signal_date quarter determines model; fit cutoff previous quarter final calendar day 23:59 Asia/Shanghai
inner: Last 6 calendar months of mature signals; purge training intervals whose exit >= minimum validation entry
retrain: Inner selected n_estimators; refit all mature eligible training rows at cutoff; no outer targets in prediction input
ensemble: equal mean of 3 scores, no outer selection
E0_RES: EP20 rolling_scores audited: 36 complete prior monthly qfq stock returns regressed on CSI300 price return with intercept, rcond1e-12/rank2; next monthly residual; skip most recent completed month, mean/std(ddof1) of 11 residual months. Exact month-end quotes; unknown endpoints remain missing, no EP20 suspension/deletion fill rules. Forward hold each monthly score to subsequent weekly signal; new historical-proxy price basis explicitly labelled.
quintiles: ascending score then instrument lexicographic; group=floor(5*ordinal/N)+1, ordinal starts0; no missing-score fill
cost_definition: all-in execution friction proxy including slippage; fees on actual gross buy/sell value; cash retained
turnover: 0.5*(sum(abs(target_stock-pretrade_stock))+abs(target_cash-pretrade_cash)); separate executed buys/NAV and sells/NAV; initial entry exempt cap but pays fees

B.projection: Euclidean least squares; untradeable holdings fixed; cash/nonnegative holdings hard; other breaches explicitly logged

weight_availability: No historic publication timestamp in Tushare snapshots: formal B unavailable. Reconstructed proxy only after snapshot date + one market session close; no future snapshot use; new members without known weights remain unknown, not zero.
industry: Retrospective historical interval L1 proxy; no strict vintage certification
account_gate: No assumed fills when critical state absent; no carrying unsupported prices as certified NAV; detailed branch blockers if source cannot close

statistics.bootstrap: circular moving block of weekly observations; same time block across models; preserve entire cross-section
statistics.icir: mean weekly RankIC / sample sd, not annualized

robustness: biweekly anchor first full 2021 weekly signal even ordinal
one extra market day execution delay
outcome_trials: All 7 registered models including missing E0-RES; E2/E3 3 seeds; no tuning after outcomes
outlier_handling: No target winsorization; invalid/nonpositive/conflicting endpoints unknown. Train-only transforms; ratios reanchor invariant. Source disagreement sensitivity flags never predictors.
B_proxy_missing_weight_rule: If most recent available monthly snapshot constituent set differs from signal universe or any benchmark drift price is missing: no B/B0 orders that week, retain actual positions and cash, record target_unavailable and legacy holdings. This is a separately labelled deferred-rebalance reconstructed-weight proxy, not the fully specified formal B. Never assign new members zero weight.
proxy_account: Synthetic qfq units: consistently use qfq open/close for holdings and NAV, raw open and vendor trade status and raw daily limits only for fill gates; no claim actual share/cash-dividend replication. Unknown held open/close valuation stops account certification at first affected date; do not carry unsupported old marks.
execution_gates: Positive raw/qfq open, vendor_trade_status==1, raw limits finite and lower<upper. Reject buys at/above upper and sells at/below lower within 0.000001 yuan. Unknown state means no order; volume not used as opening-time fill evidence. No book depth/liquidity certification.
B_proxy_industry: Historical L1 intervals from EP32; if no unique known interval use UNKNOWN group and disclose affected benchmark weight; this is a proxy constraint only.
